purpose: R25/K025 video-aware database/object backup and offline restore with the same Loom journal protocol

required_verified_build_args.NODE_IMAGE: Official Node 22 Bookworm or Bookworm slim tag plus verified sha256 digest; no unpinned default
required_verified_build_args.POSTGRES_IMAGE: Official PostgreSQL 17 Bookworm tag plus verified sha256 digest; no unpinned default
required_verified_build_args.MC_IMAGE: Reviewed minio/mc, quay.io/minio/mc, or existing bitnamilegacy/minio-client tag plus verified sha256 digest; no unpinned default

backup_journal_mount: read-only independent volume; checkpoint/verify perform no journal writes and refuse active/uncertain writers
restore_journal_mount: read-write, same latest independently retained volume; all journal clients stopped
inventory_limit: SPDX installed-package inventory is partial, with NOASSERTION licenses; not a complete file SBOM, legal approval or production deployment
